name: slide-sections
body: A top-level `# name` heading in a slide starts a section named `name`; the section runs until the next `#` heading or end of file. Content between the slide's `---` frontmatter and the first `#` heading is the slide's own body, not a section. Only one level of sections in Markdown. Section names must be declared by the slide's template; undeclared name = error with suggestion; repeat count outside the template's min/max = error.
